PROTECTION, EMPOWERMENT OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

REGIONAL GAZETTE OF CIREBON REGENCY

NUMBER 1 OF 2018 SERIES E.1

CHAPTER I

CHAPTER IV
Article 6
heading_path: RIGHTS OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN FROM ACTS OF VIOLENCE

heading: CHAPTER V
Article 8
Article 9
translated_text:
Article 9

1. The obligations and responsibilities of the Private Sector and society as referred to in Article 7 letter b, are implemented in the form of community participation and jointly.
2. Forms of participation of the private sector and society as referred to in paragraph (1), include:
a. Preventing the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children;
b. Providing information and/or reporting acts of violence against women and children to law enforcement or authorized parties; and
c. Participating in the handling of victims of acts of violence.
3. Forms of community participation as referred to in paragraph (2), are implemented responsibly in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

heading: Article 10
translated_text:
Article 10

The obligations of family and/or parents as referred to in Article 7 letter c and letter d, who legally have full responsibility to prevent all forms of violence and protect women and children as family members.

heading: CHAPTER VI
Article 12
heading_path: ROLE OF GOVERNMENT, PRIVATE SECTOR AND COMMUNITY INSTITUTIONS

heading: CHAPTER VII
Article 14
heading_path: SERVICES FOR VICTIMS OF ACTS OF VIOLENCE
translated_text:
Article 14

1. The Regional Government is obliged to provide complaint services for protection, empowerment of women and children.
2. The Regional Government and society or social service institutions may establish recovery houses or safe houses.

heading: Article 15
heading_path: SERVICES FOR VICTIMS OF ACTS OF VIOLENCE
translated_text:
Article 15

Further provisions regarding complaint services and social services as referred to in Article 14 are regulated by Regent Regulation.

heading: CHAPTER VIII
translated_text:
CHAPTER VIII

INSTITUTIONAL

Article 16

1. In the context of providing protection services to women and children from acts of violence, the Regional Government establishes an Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A) or by another name as an integrated service center in the protection of women and children from acts of violence including victims of acts of violence.
2. The Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A) or by another name as referred to in paragraph (1), functions as a leading sector for integrated service centers in providing protection to women and children from acts of violence.
3. Further provisions regarding the organization and working procedures of the Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A) or by another name as referred to in paragraph (1), are stipulated by Regent Regulation.

heading: Article 17
Article 18
translated_text:
Article 18

1. The task forces and regional action committee as referred to in Article 17 constitute a coordinating body tasked with coordinating the prevention and handling of trafficking in persons.
2. Further provisions regarding the establishment, duties, and functions of the task forces as referred to in paragraph (1), shall be stipulated by Regent Regulation.

heading: CHAPTER IX
translated_text:
CHAPTER IX

COOPERATION AND PARTNERSHIP

Part One

Cooperation

heading: Article 19
Part Two
translated_text:
Part Two

Partnership

heading: Article 20
translated_text:
Article 20

1. The Regional Government shall establish partnerships with the business sector in the protection of women and children from acts of violence.
2. Partnership as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be carried out through:
a. Notification of employment opportunity information for women victims of acts of violence;
b. Education and training for women victims of acts of violence;
c. Educational assistance for women and children victims of acts of violence who have been withdrawn from their education; and
d. Fostering and increasing economic independence of women victims of acts of violence.
3. Partnership as referred to in paragraph (1) and paragraph (2), shall be set forth in the form of an agreement.

heading: CHAPTER X
translated_text:
CHAPTER X

GUIDANCE AND SUPERVISION

Article 21

1. The Regional Government is obligated to conduct guidance and supervision of the implementation of protection, empowerment of women and children.
2. Guidance as referred to in paragraph (1), includes:
a. Guidelines and fulfillment standards;
b. Technical guidance and training;
c. Provision of facilities;
d. Monitoring; and
e. evaluation.
3. Guidance as referred to in paragraph (2), is in order to realize the objectives of protection, empowerment of women and children in accordance with minimum service standards implemented by SKPD and the community.
4. Supervision as referred to in paragraph (1), shall be carried out with professional, transparent, and accountable principles.

heading: Article 22
translated_text:
Article 22

The community may conduct supervision of the implementation of protection empowerment, of women and children organized by the Regional Government through the mechanism of conveying aspirations to the Regent or to the DPRD.

heading: CHAPTER XI
translated_text:
CHAPTER XI

FINANCING

Article 23

Financing for the implementation of protection, Empowerment of women and children is sourced from:
a. State Revenue and Expenditure Budget (APBN);
b. Regional Revenue and Expenditure Budget (APBD); and
c. Other legitimate sources in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

heading: Article 24
translated_text:
Article 24

1. The Regional Government may provide financial assistance to community organizations, social organizations or non-governmental organizations that implement protection, empowerment of women and children from discrimination and acts of violence.
2. Financial assistance as referred to in paragraph (1), shall be in accordance with regional financial capacity, and implemented in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations in the field of regional finance.

heading: CHAPTER XII
translated_text:
CHAPTER XII

CLOSING PROVISIONS

Article 25

This Regional Regulation shall come into force on the date of promulgation.

In order that everyone may know of it, the promulgation of this Regional Regulation is ordered by placing it in the Regional Gazette of Cirebon Regency.
